discovery_candidates.name: penpot
discovery_candidates.description: Penpot: The open-source design platform for Product teams that need scalable collaboration.

install_startup.recipe_modification_note: Used the project's own official, fully prebuilt-image compose file (docker/images/docker-compose.yaml) as-is - frontend/backend/exporter/mcp/postgres/valkey/mailcatch, no build needed. One fix required: the frontend's nginx crash-looped binding IPv6 ('socket() [::]:8080 failed') in this sandbox's IPv4-only Docker network - the file already ships a commented-out PENPOT_DISABLE_IPV6_LISTEN flag for exactly this case, just needed uncommenting. Fresh install had no user account, so the crawler's login attempt correctly failed with 'Email or password is incorrect' - signed up once via the app's own registration form (email verification is disabled via the compose file's own PENPOT_FLAGS) using the pipeline's standard libwalker/Walker-Pass-2026! test credentials, landing on a real working Projects dashboard with templates and an onboarding survey modal.
